fields.options:

Prior qualification
fields.description: What eligibility is judged on. School results: points and subjects. Work experience: the minimum age, then admissions decides. Studies elsewhere / here: admissions and the faculty decide credits or return. Prior qualification: the programme's minimum NQF level and average.

fields.label: Minimum Age
fields.description: On the first day of the academic year applied for. 0: none.

fields.label: Minimum Years of Work
fields.description: Relevant work experience, e.g. 5 for Mature Age Entry. 0: none.

fields.label: Who It Is For
fields.description: Shown to applicants when they choose a pathway.

fields.label: Documents for This Pathway
fields.description: In addition to the identity documents every applicant uploads.

name: Admission Pathway
description: An entry pathway into the university (school leaver, Mature Age Entry, Recognition of Prior Learning, credit transfer, re-admission, postgraduate): who it is for, the evidence it needs and its documents.
